title: Gold Trades Near 15-Month Low as Federal Reserve Rate Hike Expectations Weigh on Prices
summary: Gold prices declined on Wednesday, remaining close to their lowest levels in 15 months as expectations of further monetary tightening by the US Federal Reserve and a stronger dollar continued to weigh on precious metals. Investors remained cautious ahead of the publication of key US inflation figures later in the session, which could influence expectations for the central bank’s December interest rate decision.
